_comment: GENERATED by mcp/src/manifest.js from mcp/src/index.js. Do not edit by hand — run: node src/manifest.js

tools.name: orbitra_all_offers
tools.description: Compact list of active offers (id + name), handy for picking an offer_id when building streams.

tools.name: orbitra_api_request
tools.description: Advanced: call any Orbitra api.php endpoint directly. Use when no dedicated tool exists. method=GET for reads, POST for writes (needs a write key). See docs/api.md for actions.

params.description: Query-string params (for GET or extra POST params).

steps: forward an arbitrary action chosen by the caller

tools.name: orbitra_bulk_create_campaigns
tools.description: Create many campaigns in one call. Pass an array; each item needs at least name and alias. Returns a per-item result with new ids/tokens or errors.

id.description: Of an existing stream: update it in place.

offers.description: Offers to rotate: [{id, weight}]. Weights are relative (100 = all traffic for one offer).

schema_custom.description: Stream schema OBJECT, e.g. {"offers":[{"id":170,"weight":100}]}. Not a bare array. For schema_type 'redirect' also set offer_id to the first offer.

tools.name: orbitra_bulk_set_campaign_domain
tools.description: Move many campaigns to other tracking domains in ONE call. Changes only the campaign domain — streams, filters, offers and postbacks are not touched (unlike update_campaign, which re-saves the whole campaign). Pass items:[{id, domain_id}] for a per-campaign mapping, or ids + domain_id to put them all on one domain (domain_id null unbinds). Returns old_link/new_link for every campaign.

ids.description: Campaign ids that all go to domain_id.

tools.name: orbitra_campaign_report
tools.description: Detailed breakdown report for a campaign (by stream/offer/geo etc.).

tools.name: orbitra_campaign_rules
tools.description: List the automation rules of a campaign ("if these numbers over the last N hours, then notify / pause the campaign / switch an offer or landing off in the split").

tools.name: orbitra_campaigns_stats
tools.description: Campaigns WITH full traffic stats (clicks, conversions, revenue, ROI, ~130 fields per campaign). Heavy: with many campaigns the answer is megabytes — prefer orbitra_list_campaigns to find campaigns and orbitra_campaign_report for one campaign. limit keeps only campaigns that had clicks in the period, capped to N.

limit.description: Only campaigns with clicks > 0 in the period, capped to N.

tools.name: orbitra_check_domain_dns
tools.description: Check DNS resolution for a domain (does it point at this server yet).

tools.name: orbitra_copy_campaign
tools.description: Duplicate an existing campaign (with its streams).

tools.name: orbitra_create_campaign
tools.description: Create a new campaign. Requires name and alias. Returns the new id and Click API token. Optionally pass streams (offers/rotation).

id.description: Of an existing stream: update it in place.

offers.description: Offers to rotate: [{id, weight}]. Weights are relative (100 = all traffic for one offer).

schema_custom.description: Stream schema OBJECT, e.g. {"offers":[{"id":170,"weight":100}]}. Not a bare array. For schema_type 'redirect' also set offer_id to the first offer.

tools.name: orbitra_create_domain
tools.description: Add a tracking domain. After DNS points to the server you can trigger SSL separately in the UI. cloudflare_create_zone=true provisions the CF zone when it does not exist yet and delegates the registrar (Namecheap/Dynadot) to Cloudflare's name servers.

index_campaign_id.description: Campaign to serve on the root path.

cloudflare_create_zone.description: Create the domain's Cloudflare zone when no account has it, reveal the assigned name servers and set them at the registrar holding the domain (Namecheap/Dynadot). The token needs Zone:Edit; a missing registrar leaves the NS for the operator.

tools.name: orbitra_create_landing
tools.description: Create a landing page entry (external URL). For local ZIP landings use the Orbitra UI upload.

tools.name: orbitra_create_local_landing
tools.description: Create a new local landing (or a static copy of an existing local landing via copy_from_id). Never overwrites live pages. Optionally write initial index.html or files (HTML/CSS/JS/SVG/JSON/TXT only; no PHP).

name.description: Name for the new local landing.

copy_from_id.description: Optional existing local landing id to copy static files from (for translation or adaptation).

slug.description: Optional URL folder slug (auto-generated from name if omitted).

files.description: Optional additional static files to create.

tools.name: orbitra_create_local_offer
tools.description: Create a new local offer (is_local=1) or a static copy of an existing local offer via copy_from_id. Optionally write initial index.html or static files (HTML/CSS/JS/SVG/JSON/TXT only; no PHP).

name.description: Name for the new local offer.

copy_from_id.description: Optional existing local offer id to copy static files and defaults from.

files.description: Optional additional static files to create.

tools.name: orbitra_create_offer
tools.description: Create a new offer.

redirect_type.description: How the visitor is sent to the offer. One of: 'redirect' (HTTP 302, default), 'js' (client-side window.location), 'meta_refresh' (meta refresh tag), 'frame'/'iframe' (rendered in a full-page iframe), 'form_submit' (auto-submitted POST form), 'preload'/'curl_proxy' (remote page served through this server).

tools.name: orbitra_create_traffic_source
tools.description: Create a traffic source. Use orbitra_list_traffic_source_templates first to grab a template + parameters for known platforms.

template.description: Template key, e.g. facebook, tiktok, google_ads.

parameters_json.description: Token/param mapping object or JSON string.

tools.name: orbitra_creative_detail
tools.description: One creative from the library: per-day metrics series, the ads that ran it (with statuses and spend) and near-duplicate family.

tools.name: orbitra_creatives_top
tools.description: Creative library: creatives by spend/revenue/ROI over a period (the Creatives tab). Answers "which creatives are burning out".

tools.name: orbitra_crm_lead_evidence
tools.description: Admin-only. Fetch full anti-shaving evidence for one CRM lead by numeric id or click_id: raw & E.164 phone, exact network API request/response, S2S postbacks, flags and a ready-to-send support summary.

click_id.description: ClickID / SubID if numeric id is not known.

tools.name: orbitra_crm_leads
tools.description: Admin-only. List CRM vault leads with anti-shaving reconciliation flags and KPI totals (total, approved, processing, rejected, trash, suspects, lost, duplicates, revenue). Use status="suspect", "lost", or "duplicate" to check for shaving.

status.description: Filter by lead status or anti-shaving flag.

search.description: Search by click_id, customer name, raw/clean phone, network lead id or network.

tools.name: orbitra_crm_update_lead
tools.description: Admin-only. Manually update a CRM lead status (and optional payout); also updates the matching conversion row.

tools.name: orbitra_delete_campaign
tools.description: Soft-delete a campaign (moves it to the archive).

tools.name: orbitra_delete_domain
tools.description: Delete a tracking domain.

tools.name: orbitra_delete_offer
tools.description: Delete an offer.

tools.name: orbitra_get_campaign
tools.description: Full details of one campaign including its streams (rotation/filters/offers) and postbacks.

tools.name: orbitra_get_chart
tools.description: Time-series chart data (clicks and conversions per day/hour) for building trend views.

tools.name: orbitra_get_integration_code
tools.description: Ready-to-paste integration code for a campaign: KClient JS/PHP, tracking script, banners, ad-network snippets (link/iframe/script), click/conversion pixel, countdown widget, Back Button trap, exit-intent popup, WordPress shortcodes, plain campaign URL. Generated by the SAME generator the panel uses, with the campaign's own https domain, token and id already substituted — what you get is what the Tracking tab would copy. The tracker address defaults to the campaign's bound domain (its https host) and falls back to the panel's own origin; pass tracker_url to override, e.g. a CDN front. options carries per-method knobs as an object: pixel {pixel_type:"conversion", conv_status:"sale", payout, subid_param}, countdown {hours, minutes, theme:"purple|emerald|fire|dark", header_text, button_text, offer_url, expire_action:"redirect", expire_url}, back_button {trap_url, delay, log_click:false}, exit_intent {heading, text, popup_button_text, button_color, offer_url, show_delay, close_on_backdrop}, banner_script/banner_iframe {width, height}, kclient_js {base64:true}, kclient_php {send_params:false}.

tracker_url.description: Base URL written into the code; default = the campaign domain or the panel origin.

options.description: Per-method options object, see the tool description.

steps: stringify options object into ONE query param

tools.name: orbitra_get_metrics
tools.description: Aggregated dashboard metrics (clicks, unique clicks, conversions, revenue, cost, profit) for a period. Use for "how are my campaigns doing" style questions.

tools.name: orbitra_get_offer
tools.description: Full details of one offer.

tools.name: orbitra_integrations_status
tools.description: What is connected on this tracker, in one call: Cloudflare (accounts, proxied domains), the Telegram bot, and traffic sources with their OAuth/token state (Facebook, TikTok, Google Ads, custom). Each section reports its own connected/error state — one failing section never hides the rest.
steps: each into its own section, per-section errors

tools.name: orbitra_link_check_now
tools.description: Book link checks for the worker's next run (within a minute): pass ids from orbitra_link_checks_list. Capped at 100 per 10 minutes — every check of an offer link is a click in the partner network's statistics. Write key required.

tools.name: orbitra_link_checks_list
tools.description: Link checks: the offers and domains the tracker opens on a schedule, with status, the reason in words, last and next check and the redirect chain of the last check. Problems come first. Filters: type (offer|domain), status (failed|warning|ok|pending|problem), q (name or URL). Pass an id to get one link.

tools.name: orbitra_link_checks_summary
tools.description: Link checks: how many tracked offers and domains are OK / need attention / broken — the number behind the badge in the panel. Read-only.

tools.name: orbitra_list_affiliate_networks
tools.description: List affiliate/CPA networks.

tools.name: orbitra_list_app_configs
tools.description: App Configs stored on the tracker: named JSON payloads (stub page, banner, WebView config) served publicly at /api.php?action=app_config&key=<config_key> for landings and third-party sites. Each row carries its config_key, the campaign it can be bound to and its payload.

tools.name: orbitra_list_campaigns
tools.description: Compact campaign list: id, name, alias, state, domain and the public link — no stats, so it stays small with thousands of campaigns. Paged (limit/offset, meta.next_offset) and filterable by id range or domain. The primary way to find campaign IDs; use orbitra_campaigns_stats for metrics.

domain_id.description: Only campaigns bound to this domain.

domain_suffix.description: Only campaigns whose domain ends with this, e.g. ".ru".

offset.description: Rows to skip; pass meta.next_offset for the next page.

tools.name: orbitra_list_conversions
tools.description: Conversion log with filters and pagination.

status.description: Filter by status: lead, sale, rejected, trash, ...

tools.name: orbitra_list_domains
tools.description: Compact list of tracking domains: id, name, status, cached DNS/SSL state, Cloudflare proxy, admin access and how many active campaigns use each. Optional suffix filter (e.g. ".de").

suffix.description: Only domains ending with this, e.g. ".de".

tools.name: orbitra_list_landing_files
tools.description: List text/code files inside a local landing folder (e.g. index.html, styles.css, app.js). Use before reading or translating a landing.

tools.name: orbitra_list_landings
tools.description: List landing pages.

tools.name: orbitra_list_offer_files
tools.description: List files inside a local offer folder (offers/<id>/).

tools.name: orbitra_list_offers
tools.description: List offers with basic stats.

tools.name: orbitra_list_traffic_source_templates
tools.description: List built-in traffic source templates (Facebook, TikTok, Google Ads, ...) with their default parameters.

tools.name: orbitra_list_traffic_sources
tools.description: List traffic sources (Facebook, TikTok, Google Ads, etc.) with their postback config.

tools.name: orbitra_ping
tools.description: Verify connectivity and credentials. Returns the configured Orbitra URL and live system status (DB size, click/conversion counts, resource usage).

tools.name: orbitra_read_landing_file
tools.description: Read a file from a local landing folder (e.g. "index.html", "styles.css").

path.description: Relative file path inside the landing folder.

tools.name: orbitra_read_offer_file
tools.description: Read a file from a local offer folder (e.g. "index.html").

path.description: Relative file path inside the offer folder.

tools.name: orbitra_recent_clicks
tools.description: Recent raw clicks (the "Recent Clicks" table).

tools.name: orbitra_reissue_ssl
tools.description: Issue or re-issue the Let's Encrypt certificate for ONE domain now, synchronously — certbot runs for tens of seconds, so expect a slow answer. Doubles as "issue now" for a first certificate. Refuses Cloudflare-proxied domains (their SSL is at the edge) and domains whose DNS does not point at this server; the error says which IP was expected and which was seen, so diagnose with orbitra_ssl_environment / orbitra_check_domain_dns before retrying. Admin API key required. Mind the Let's Encrypt rate limits (50 certs per registered domain per week) when looping over many domains — prefer orbitra_run_ssl_worker, which respects the retry backoff.

tools.name: orbitra_run_ssl_worker
tools.description: Work the certificate queue once, now, instead of waiting for cron: issues up to 5 pending certificates (respecting the failure backoff and the DNS gate), re-probes already-installed ones, and returns counters plus the environment report (certbot present, detected server IP). Slow — certbot runs per domain, so a full batch can take minutes. Call repeatedly while domains remain pending; if domains sit in waiting_dns although their DNS points here, check the reported server_ip (fixable via the server_ip_override setting). Admin API key required.

tools.name: orbitra_save_app_config
tools.description: Create or update an App Config (named JSON payload served at /api.php?action=app_config&key=<config_key>). Pass id to update; without id a new config_key is minted. config_json may be an object or a JSON string. Set is_active=false to keep the entry but serve {"active":false}.

id.description: Existing config id to update; omit to create.

config_json.description: The payload: object or JSON string.

tools.name: orbitra_save_campaign_rule
tools.description: Create or update a campaign rule. target: campaign | offers | landings (each offer/landing in the campaign split is judged separately). action: notify (Telegram only) | pause_campaign (campaign target) | disable_item (offers/landings target; never switches off the last enabled item). Conditions are ANDed; ROI and CR are percentages. Pass id to update.

tools.name: orbitra_save_text_test
tools.description: Create or update a text A/B test on a page the tracker serves itself: a local landing (landing_id) or a local offer page (offer_id), exactly one of the two. original_text must be text that is on the page (see orbitra_text_test_candidates); variants are the alternatives (the original is always kept as the control). mode auto shifts traffic to the likely winner; equal keeps an even split. Pass id to update.
steps: POST text_test_save with every variant marked source=ai — the model wrote it

tools.name: orbitra_set_campaign_state
tools.description: Start or stop a campaign. A stopped (paused) campaign keeps its settings but no longer serves traffic. Stopping spend usually means pausing the ads at the traffic source too: pass sync_ads=true for that, as the panel's switch does.

sync_ads.description: Also pause/resume the linked ad-network campaigns (Facebook, TikTok…). Default false.

tools.name: orbitra_set_rotation_weights
tools.description: Set the weights of offers or landings inside one stream's rotation. Items you do not list keep theirs. Refused while auto-optimisation manages that list (pass turn_off_auto to switch it off here). Returns the items with their shares.

weight.description: New weight: share of traffic in %.

turn_off_auto.description: Switch auto-optimisation off for the lists you are changing.

tools.name: orbitra_set_stream_active
tools.description: Switch streams of a campaign on or off; the rest of the campaign is not touched. The last enabled stream cannot be switched off: stop the campaign instead (orbitra_set_campaign_state).

tools.name: orbitra_set_stream_weights
tools.description: Set the traffic share (weight, %) of one or more streams of a campaign. Streams you do not list keep their weight. Stream ids come from orbitra_get_campaign. Returns every stream with its resulting share.

weight.description: New weight: share of traffic in %.

rotation_type.description: Pass 'weight' to switch the campaign to rotation by weight; the default 'position' ignores stream weights.

tools.name: orbitra_ssl_environment
tools.description: Read-only SSL diagnostics: whether this server can issue certificates at all (certbot installed, sudo rule for the web user, ACME dir writable) and the detected server IP that DNS pre-flights compare A records against. When domains sit in waiting_dns despite DNS pointing at the server, call this first: a wrong detected IP is fixed with the server_ip_override setting, environment problems are fixed on the server. Admin API key required.

tools.name: orbitra_system_status
tools.description: Server/system status: DB size, disk, memory, PHP/SQLite info, geo DB status.

tools.name: orbitra_telegram_status
tools.description: Telegram bot state: connected or not, bot username, webhook vs polling mode, last poll run and last error, notify/daily settings. Read-only.

tools.name: orbitra_text_test_candidates
tools.description: Texts on a page the tracker serves itself that can be A/B tested (title, headings, buttons, paragraphs), exactly as the tracker can find them on the page. landing_id for a local landing, offer_id for a local offer page — exactly one of the two.

tools.name: orbitra_text_tests
tools.description: Text A/B tests of a page the tracker serves itself — a local landing (landing_id) or a local offer page (offer_id); exactly one of the two. Each test swaps one piece of text (headline, paragraph, button) for variants and reports views, conversions and the probability each variant is best. The goal follows the page: lp CTR (the share who went on to the offer) on a landing, the conversion rate on an offer page.

tools.name: orbitra_update_campaign
tools.description: Update an existing campaign. Only the fields you pass are changed. A stream carrying the id of an existing stream is updated in place (only its sent fields change), one without an id is added, streams you do not mention stay; delete_stream_ids removes. For weights, on/off or the campaign's state use orbitra_set_stream_weights, orbitra_set_stream_active, orbitra_set_rotation_weights, orbitra_set_campaign_state. Postbacks you pass replace the old list.

id.description: Of an existing stream: update it in place.

offers.description: Offers to rotate: [{id, weight}]. Weights are relative (100 = all traffic for one offer).

schema_custom.description: Stream schema OBJECT, e.g. {"offers":[{"id":170,"weight":100}]}. Not a bare array. For schema_type 'redirect' also set offer_id to the first offer.

streams.description: Streams to update or add. With the id of an existing stream: only the fields you send change. Without an id: added. Streams not mentioned stay.

postbacks.description: Replace postbacks. Omit to keep existing.

steps: merge fields; patch streams by id, unmentioned stay, delete_stream_ids removes

tools.name: orbitra_update_offer
tools.description: Update an existing offer. Only fields you pass are changed (re-reads the offer and merges).

redirect_type.description: How the visitor is sent to the offer. One of: 'redirect' (HTTP 302, default), 'js' (client-side window.location), 'meta_refresh' (meta refresh tag), 'frame'/'iframe' (rendered in a full-page iframe), 'form_submit' (auto-submitted POST form), 'preload'/'curl_proxy' (remote page served through this server).

tools.name: orbitra_write_landing_file
tools.description: Create or update one static file (HTML, CSS, JS, SVG, JSON, TXT) inside a local landing. Refuses to edit landings used by an active campaign — copy them first with orbitra_create_local_landing. PHP is blocked.

tools.name: orbitra_write_offer_file
tools.description: Create or update one static file (HTML, CSS, JS, SVG, JSON, TXT) inside a local offer. Refuses to edit offers used by an active campaign — copy them first with orbitra_create_local_offer. PHP is blocked.
